title: DepoAudio export manifest, version 1
description: Written by DepoAudio as <output>.depoaudio.json next to each converted file. It records what was converted, by which build, and how. It never contains folder paths. Mirror of src-tauri/src/manifest.rs; a Rust test checks real manifests against this file.

createdAt.description: UTC time the manifest was written (RFC 3339, seconds).

fileName.description: File name only, never a folder path.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original file as selected, before any format preparation.

fileName.description: File name only; the manifest sits next to this file.

filterOption.description: The FFmpeg option that carried filterChain, or null when no filter ran.

filterChain.description: The exact FFmpeg filter string used. In split mode it is the whole graph; channel.sourceChannelIndex names this file's branch.

encoderArgs.description: The exact FFmpeg encoder and metadata arguments for this output, without file paths.

sourceChannelIndex.description: Zero-based source channel for a split file (FFmpeg c0 is 0); null otherwise.

label.description: The channel or microphone label the person entered for this split file.

labels.description: Labels entered for each source channel, in channel order.

sourceTimeReferenceSamples.description: BWF bext TimeReference of the source: samples since midnight at sourceSampleRate.

outputTimeReferenceSamples.description: The same start, rescaled to output.sampleRate. Null when the output start differs from the source start (leading-silence trim) or the start is unknown.

writtenToOutput.description: True when the output WAV carries outputTimeReferenceSamples in its own bext chunk. When false, the output carries no time_reference at all and this record is the only place the start is kept.
